Hi everyone,

I've been getting this error when trying to host a single application with Shiny Server:

Would the top error be an error in the actual code of my application, and the bottom a problem with server side pathing or ENV? Or maybe with the Shiny and/or Shiny Server install?

A related question would be how to handle working directories on a hosted application. Not knowing how Shiny Server handles this, I've put in setwd() to the top of my server.r and related codes. But if I'm just hosting one folder, do I even have to do that?
I'm very much a novice with Shiny Server and Ubuntu, so any and all help would be greatly appreciated. 

Thanks very much,

Chandler

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Error Hosting Single App
parts:
Chandler,

In recent versions of Shiny Server, the working directory is set to be the same as the dir in which the application is housed.

Shiny needs to be installed for the user running the application, which is often the `shiny` user (see documentation for the run_as setting in the docs). I'd recommend logging in as that user (`sudo -i ; su shiny`), opening R, and trying to `library(shiny)`. You'll need to make sure that command can execute properly before Shiny Server will be able to start Shiny processes for you.

Jeff

owd = setwd(tempdir())
